notes.title: Scamper v20+
notes.content: [p]Scamper is a constantly evolving Virtual Reality.[/p][p][/p][p]The latest update, [b]v20.5[/b], elevates v20 with upgraded visuals, smoother movement, and a more polished experience. With v20.5, the in-game Monitor now keeps you up to date on reality developments.[/p][p][/p][p]These v20 updates prepare the path to v21, where more environments arrive.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]v20 Launch Trailer[/b][/p][previewyoutube="2RWqOr59L3k;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v20.5
notes.content:
----- v20.5 -----
> Improved visuals
> Improved monitor
> Improved movement
> Added settings
> Fixed reality lags
> Fixed reality glitches

notes.title: v19.33
notes.content:
-Made climbing ladders easier with grip climbing
-Added Rat Sounds option (makes other players sound like rats)
-Improved AI
-Numerous small fixes and improvements

notes.title: v19.27 Update
notes.content:
- Improved both AIs
- Added more button spawn points
- Added an option to enable/disable collisions with other rats

notes.title: v19.21 Update
notes.content:
This update lets you spectate what's happening in the sewer through the monitor in multiplayer.
If you get eaten and respawn, you can now choose to spectate at spawn, or re-enter the sewer if the door has been opened by those still inside.

notes.title: v19 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 'Insane' difficulty
[*] Added difficulty selection to multiplayer
[*] Revamped UI system (monitor)
[*] Added a new volumetric audio system (realistic reverb, spatial sound, etc)
[*] Added different colors for your rat body (you can change it in the new settings menu)
[*] A bunch of small gameplay improvements and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Scamper Multiplayer is out now! 

You can go alone with multiple difficulty levels to choose from, or with other rats in multiplayer.
Featuring dynamic rat avatars, proximity voice chat, and more!

[b]It is time to enter the sewer[/b]



Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added multiplayer mode
[*] Improved UI
[*] Improved AI and animation
[*] Numerous other improvements and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed lag spiking in that one hallway
- Fixed a bug where buttons didn't reset
